name: Stripe Agent Toolkit
description: Stripe's open-source toolkit for giving agents payment and billing tools.
descriptionZh: Stripe 的开源工具包，为 Agent 提供支付与计费工具。
keyFact: Stripe Agent Toolkit was released in November 2024 and is MIT-licensed; it ships as @stripe/agent-toolkit and integrates with LangChain, the Vercel AI SDK and MCP, and Stripe also exposes a remote MCP server at mcp.stripe.com authorized via OAuth.
keyFactZh: Stripe Agent Toolkit 于 2024 年 11 月发布，采用 MIT 许可；以 @stripe/agent-toolkit 形式提供并集成 LangChain、Vercel AI SDK 与 MCP，此外 Stripe 还通过 OAuth 授权提供远端 MCP 服务器 mcp.stripe.com。
